Appreciate the detail, Sam — and thanks for the spreadsheet. Looping in David from security and Priyom from product so they can confirm the technical specifics. Quick answers up front: 

- BYOK/HSM: Redwood supports BYOK in Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted (multi-tenant) we offer integration with customer KMS providers for key wrapping, but importing raw key material into a Redwood-managed HSM is only available with Private deployments or via CloudHSM in a Dedicated VPC setup. Key rotation is supported; we use envelope encryption so rotations can be performed with minimal/no downtime if keys are properly staged. Cross-region replication depends on whether you want keys to be exportable — most customers keep keys in the primary region (us-east-1) and replicate model artifacts instead.

- In-transit/At-rest: all network traffic uses TLS 1.2+ (we recommend TLS 1.3). At-rest encryption uses AES-256 with envelope encryption and keys stored in customer KMS when BYOK is enabled.

- Logs & PII: we provide route-level logging controls (enable/disable), transcript redaction (regex-based and configurable), and configurable retention windows (you can set 0-3650 days, with options for immediate purge). Audit logs are available and can be forwarded to your SIEM/CloudWatch.

Would David and Priyom be able to join the follow-up call to flesh out the CloudHSM import steps and the exact rotation runbook? Proposed time still looks like Mon 5/17 10:00 PT — I can send a calendar invite if that works.

Hi Sam — David here (Security). Wanted to add technical detail so you have everything for your internal review: 

- CloudHSM & BYOK: For Dedicated we can provision a VPC peering model where your CloudHSM cluster lives in your AWS account. You can import keys directly or use HSM-generated keys. For Private (on-prem) we support FIPS 140-2 validated HSMs and on-site key control. Key rotation: we recommend a staged rotation (create new key, re-wrap data keys, cutover) — our envelope encryption keeps data keys re-wrapping fast so application downtime is typically not required. We will provide a runbook and test plan.

- Cross-region: if you require keys to be present in us-east-1 only, we can restrict replication. Some managed features (global routing/failover) may require regional considerations; happy to detail tradeoffs.

- Logs & audit: audit logs (admin actions, key access events) are stored separately, encrypted at rest, and can be shipped to your CloudWatch/Loggly/Splunk. For PII we support selective redaction at ingestion and a policy-driven retention that can be set to 90 days.

- Compliance: Redwood's Hosted and Dedicated offerings run in SOC 2 compliant environments; Private deployments can be configured to meet HIPAA requirements with BAAs. We'll include relevant artifacts in the security packet if you want them.

Next: Marissa — please confirm if Mon 5/17 10:00 PT works and I'll join the call. Sam — if you can confirm which deployment model Aurora prefers (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and whether keys must be in your AWS account, we'll prepare detailed steps for the call.
